messages.author: 18ff58b0d6f4d5c4
messages.subject: Error running NIMBLE on Linux
parts:
I am hoping that someone can help with a problem I've recently run into using NIMBLE. I have code that works perfectly on my Windows and OS X machines but does not work using my Linux operating system. The GNU compiler suite is installed and functioning properly and the R-nimble package appears to have been installed and loaded properly (has have all of the dependencies). Here is the error that I am getting on Linux:

defining model...
Error in md$setupModel(code = code, constants = constants, dimensions = dimensions,  :
  could not find function "checkForSelfParents"


It throws the same error when running the toy example for the NIMBLE manual:

> pumpCode <- nimbleCode({
+   for (i in 1:N){
+     theta[i] ~ dgamma(alpha,beta)
+     lambda[i] <- theta[i]*t[i]
+     x[i] ~ dpois(lambda[i])
+   }
+   alpha ~ dexp(1.0)
+   beta ~ dgamma(0.1,1.0)
+ })
> pumpConsts <- list(N = 10,
+                    t = c(94.3, 15.7, 62.9, 126, 5.24,
+                          31.4, 1.05, 1.05, 2.1, 10.5))
> pumpData <- list(x = c(5, 1, 5, 14, 3, 19, 1, 1, 4, 22))
> pumpInits <- list(alpha = 1, beta = 1,
+                   theta = rep(0.1, pumpConsts$N))
> pump <- nimbleModel(code = pumpCode, name = "pump", constants = pumpConsts,
+                     data = pumpData, inits = pumpInits)
defining model...
Error in md$setupModel(code = code, constants = constants, dimensions = dimensions,  :
  could not find function "checkForSelfParents"


Here is the R Session Info:

> sessionInfo()
R version 3.3.0 (2016-05-03)
Platform: x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu (64-bit)

locale:
 [1] LC_CTYPE=en_US.UTF-8       LC_NUMERIC=C
 [3] LC_TIME=en_US.UTF-8        LC_COLLATE=en_US.UTF-8
 [5] LC_MONETARY=en_US.UTF-8    LC_MESSAGES=en_US.UTF-8
 [7] LC_PAPER=en_US.UTF-8       LC_NAME=C
 [9] LC_ADDRESS=C               LC_TELEPHONE=C
[11] LC_MEASUREMENT=en_US.UTF-8 LC_IDENTIFICATION=C

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base

other attached packages:
[1] nimble_0.6-9

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] R6_2.2.2        magrittr_1.5    parallel_3.3.0  igraph_1.2.1
[5] coda_0.19-1     grid_3.3.0      pkgconfig_2.0.1 lattice_0.20-33


Any help would be much appreciated.

Thanks!
Courtney

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: Error running NIMBLE on Linux
parts:
Hi Courtney, that error looks like some R code within the nimble
namespace not being found and not related to anything about
compilation.

I suspect something got messed up during the installation process. One
thing would just be to try to reinstall. You might want to first
remove the current installed nimble directory just for extra caution,
and when you install make sure there are no error messages reported.

If that still doesn't work, could you post (a) what is printed to the
screen when you install nimble and (b) results of the following:

library(nimble)
nimble:::modelDefClass
ls('package:nimble')

Chris

messages.subject: Re: Error running NIMBLE on Linux
parts:
I'm following up on this as the same error has come up a couple times in recent days. We don't know the cause of
the problem (perhaps something to do with the methods package given that checkForSelfParents is a
ReferenceClass method), but it seems to be associated with NIMBLE on older R versions, in particular R 3.3.1.

Upgrading R and re-installing NIMBLE has solved the problem for two users.
On Friday, March 16, 2018 at 12:19:20 PM UTC-7, Christopher Paciorek wrote:
